Multiple GPA Calculation Methods Now Available!

You can now choose how your overall GPA is calculated: using Weighted SGPA [Σ(SGPA × w) / Σw] or Weighted Module CGPA [Σ(w × C × GPV) / Σ(w × C)]. Non-GPA (NGPA) modules are excluded from all GPA calculations. Switch methods anytime using the selector in the top-right.
